ValidationRule.description: No se puede editar una alerta cerrada
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Desktop Integration" ), OR( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(almd__User_id__c), ISCHANGED(almd__mandatory_visit_type__c) ), ISPICKVAL(almd__alert_stage_type__c , 'Closed') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not edit a closed alert.
